scripts.deploy: npm run build --workspace @datamix/admin && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build --workspace @datamix/admin && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env preview
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build --workspace @datamix/admin && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env production
scripts.typecheck: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler types ./worker-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.jsonc --check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
